notes: Every issue of 1979-1981 read through the mention pass (research/tools/ocr_mentions.py): every number followed by a street name in the EAS street list, typed or one of the streets the paper prints untyped, then a filter dropping other cities, home addresses, advertisements and addresses recurring in six or more issues (advertisers and the masthead); the 364 surviving windows were read by hand. Taken: dated events at buildings, retrospective building histories, and dated occupancy by institutions, associations, churches, clinics, schools, theatres and firms. Not taken: display and classified advertising, calendar listings of one-off events at venues, the bare presence of shops, restaurants and bank branches, restaurant health-permit actions, home addresses of private people, and out-of-city pages.
